title: Dragon Vein Awakening
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji weighed the pros and cons, a faint yet clear call came from the depths of the Forbidden Grounds—that was Chen Nian's voice. And her gaze, terrifyingly clear.

text.content:
The dragon's roar shattered this ancient silence.

Chen Ji felt his eardrums buzzing, and a majestic force from the depths of the earth脉 surged forth with unstoppable momentum. He knelt on one knee, supporting himself with his palm, his face displaying perfectly calibrated panic—this expression he had rehearsed countless times, enough to deceive anyone present.

The temporal-spatial rift expanded rapidly amid the dragon's roar, the dark void's edges shimmering with eerie golden-red light, as if some ancient giant beast was awakening from slumber, ready to tear apart this world imprisoned for ten thousand years.

「The Crown Prince's Grand Teacher has arrived!」

A sharp announcement cut through the chaos. From the imperial dynasty's formation, a dozen figures transformed into flowing light, rushing directly toward the Forbidden Grounds' core. Those were true powerhouses, their speed leaving afterimages in the air. The Crown Prince's Grand Teacher led the charge, his python-robe billowing, his eyes filled with undisguised greed and ambition.

Chen Ji lowered his gaze, a barely perceptible smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

These fools. The Dragon Vein Awakening meant the Forbidden Grounds' seal had completely collapsed, and it also meant—the opportunity he had been waiting for had finally arrived.

dialogue.content:
(Murmuring to himself) Ling Yuan you old fox, why do you think I triggered the Dragon Vein Awakening at this moment?

His form flashed, and while everyone's attention was captured by the dragon's roar, he slipped into the Forbidden Grounds' entrance like a ghost. The demonic energy of the first layer was like air to him—this was precisely the result of his years of scheming.

text.content:
Seventh Layer of the Forbidden Grounds.

Chen Ji traversed the collapsed passage, underfoot broken ancient stone bricks, while golden-red Dragon Vein power occasionally slithered past overhead like serpents. The air was scorching enough to suffocate, yet it could not melt the cold light in his eyes.

Ahead, a faint yet familiar seal fluctuation pierced through layers of demonic energy into his perception.

It was Chen Nian.

His sister, missing for seven years, lay less than a hundred zhang ahead.

Seventh Layer Core, Chaotic Altar.

Chen Ji finally saw that figure his soul had been yearning for.

Chen Nian sat cross-legged at the altar's center, surrounded by dense seal chains that were snapping one by one as the Dragon Vein awakened. Between her brows, an enigmatic rune flickered in and out of visibility, emitting eerie golden light.

Her aura—no longer purely seal-bound stillness, but mixed with some kind of... vitality?

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

This doesn't feel right.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions in his heart, and began arranging the final stages of the feigned death formation.

He drew out the spiritual materials he had prepared from his sleeve, using forbidden techniques to intertwine his own aura with the Dragon Vein power. This was an extremely dangerous art—a single mistake, and he would truly become the Dragon Vein's sacrifice.

But he had the Tianji Record.

The fragment at his brow center warmed slightly, and that familiar foresight ability surged again, guiding him to each precise step.

The cost was—five Heavenly Fate Value.

「Seven years of scheming, sacrificing countless pawns, all for today.」

Chen Ji murmured to himself, his fingertip tracing the final formation rune. The instant the feigned death formation completed, a pungent death aura spread from within him, perfectly blending with the surrounding Dragon Vein power.

From external perception, the current "Chen Ji" was already a cold corpse.

While the real him stood on the boundary line between life and death, waiting for that predestined moment.

Until—

「You've arrived.」

An aged yet familiar voice sounded from the other side of the altar.

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan stood mid-air, crane-haired yet youthful-faced, his azure robe rustling in the wind. His gaze toward Chen Ji carried a hint of playfulness, like admiring an artwork he had personally carved that had unexpectedly turned out brilliantly.

「Seven years, Chen Ji. You've exceeded this old man's expectations.」

He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his body showing no aura fluctuations whatsoever, yet it made every hair on Chen Ji's body stand on end.

「This old man has come to bestow you a fortune.」

Ling Yuan waved his sleeve, and a screen of light unfolded in mid-air.

Within it, Chen Nian's face was clearly visible—that face bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, its eyes tightly closed, the rune between her brows circulating unceasingly.

「She is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key,' the only one who can open the true Ninth Page of the Tianji Record.」 Ling Yuan's voice carried no emotion whatsoever, 「This old man can help you break the remaining seal on her, allowing her to fully awaken.」

He paused, his gaze sharp as a sword:

「The condition is—she belongs to this old man.」

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's proposal lay before him; Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.description: Pretend to agree with Ling Yuan's proposal, first to stabilize this old fox, while secretly seeking an opportunity to break the deadlock. Ling Yuan's schemes run extremely deep; a hasty refusal would only startle the prey.
choices.visible_cost: Need to cooperate with Ling Yuan in this act, which might expose more trump cards.
choices.visible_reward: Buy time, deeply understand Ling Yuan's true purpose.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is not an easy opponent; he could see through at any moment.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly, then he lowered his eyelids, hiding that刺骨的寒意 in his eyes.

「What the senior said... is not entirely unreasonable.」

His voice was steady to the point of near-cold indifference, as if discussing a transaction unrelated to himself. But internally, his mind raced—What did Ling Yuan want with Chen Nian? What secrets did the Tianji Record's Ninth Page hide?

This debt, he made a mental note of.

Ling Yuan stroked his beard and smiled, a hint of satisfaction flickering in his eyes: 「A wise person knows to follow the times. Rest assured, this old man won't mistreat his own people.」

He didn't know that this 「own people」, when it fell on Chen Ji's ears, only deepened that mental note.

「However—」 Ling Yuan turned abruptly, 「Before the deal is finalized, this old man needs you to do one thing.」

choices.memory_label: 与凌渊达成初步默契，但暗中提防

choices.description: Chen Nian is his only relative; no one else dare lay a hand on her. Even if the opponent was Ling Yuan, he would not yield an inch.
choices.visible_cost: Completely break with Ling Yuan; direct confrontation might bring enormous risks.
choices.visible_reward: State the stance; the determination to never back down might bring unexpected turning points.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is unfathomably deep; the odds of victory in direct conflict are unknown.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji lifted his head abruptly, his killing intent almost solidifying into substance.

「Chen Nian is my younger sister.」

His voice was very soft, soft as a sigh. But the coldness in those eyes caused the surrounding temperature to drop several degrees.

「No one can touch her.」

For seven years, he had schemed across the world, calculated all living beings, done everything for this day. For his younger sister, he could do anything.

Even perish together with Ling Yuan.

"Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes slightly, seemingly surprised by Chen Ji's reaction.

"You are more courageous than your father." He chuckled lightly, with profound meaning. "Since that is the case... this old man will have to act personally."

As his words fell, a terrifying aura poured forth from within him, pressing down like a mountain.

Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, the Tianji Record Fragment at his brow center pulsing frantically—

The time for the next foresight had arrived."

choices.memory_label: 与凌渊彻底决裂，局势急转直下

text.content:
"On the screen, Chen Nian's face was clearly visible—that face, seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's, was now with eyes tightly shut, the talisman patterns at her brow center swirling unceasingly.

"She is the 'Heavenly Fate Key.' Only she can open the true Ninth Page of the Tianji Record." Ling Yuan's voice carried no emotion whatsoever. "This old man can help you break the remaining seals on her body, allowing her to awaken completely."

He paused, his gaze sharp as a sword:

"The condition is—she belongs to this old man."

Chen Ji fell silent for a breath.

In that breath, he thought of much. Of his childhood vow at the Chen family ancestral hall to protect his sister for her entire life. Of Chen Nian's heart-wrenching wail when he was expelled from the sect. Of every chess move he had calculated over these seven years using the Tianji Record.

Then he smiled.

"Senior Ling Yuan," he raised his head, the coldness in his eyes almost solidifying into substance, "you have calculated all heavenly secrets, yet missed one thing."

"What?"

"My life, Chen Ji's life, was never meant for trading."

dialogue.content:
"Ling Yuan's gaze turned abruptly gloomy.

"Boy, do you truly think this old man dares not touch you?" His surrounding aura surged, a terrifying pressure surging toward Chen Ji like a tide. "This old man protected you for seven years, and can also make you suffer eternal damnation!"

Chen Ji stood in place, allowing that pressure to crash against his body. His robes fluttered wildly, his hair danced in the wind, but his spine remained straight as a sword.

"Senior protected me for seven years," he spoke slowly, "merely because I still held the value of a piece you desired. Now—"

He slightly tilted his head, glancing at Chen Nian at the altar's center:

"If you wish to touch her, then this piece of yours does not mind breaking and injuring your hand."

This was naked provocation.

Using his own life, Chen Ji's life, to threaten Ling Yuan.

Silence fell over the entire area.

Ling Yuan's expression changed for the first time—rage, and also... wariness.

"You dare!"

choice.prompt: "The confrontation escalated to a white-hot intensity. Ling Yuan threatened and tempted, Chen Ji refused to yield an inch. As the situation reached a deadlock, how should Chen Ji break the impasse?"

choices.description: "Reveal to Ling Yuan the partial truth he already knows—the past of Ling Yuan being abandoned by the Tianji Record back then. Use the opponent's obsession as a bargaining chip to exchange for temporary peace."
choices.visible_cost: "Exposing the information he controls might cause Ling Yuan to accelerate his actions"
choices.visible_reward: "Disrupt Ling Yuan's rhythm, strive for breathing room"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan may have long been prepared; information warfare might not gain the upper hand"

dialogue.content:
""Senior Ling Yuan," Chen Ji's voice suddenly became very soft, soft as a sigh, "do you know why the Tianji Record did not choose you back then?"

Ling Yuan's figure froze abruptly.

That was a secret he had buried for hundreds of years, the deepest obsession when waking from midnight dreams. This waste of space—how could he possibly know?

"You..."

"The Tianji Record's selection of its master has never been about talent," Chen Ji spoke word by word, "but about—the heart."

He gazed at Ling Yuan, his eyes carrying undisguised mockery:

"Senior lost not due to talent, but because you have never understood what 'protection' means.""

choices.memory_label: 向凌渊展示自己掌握其过往秘密

choices.description: "Use Ling Yuan's urgent desire for Chen Nian, deliberately stall for time, waiting for external forces to intervene. The Imperial Prince's Grand Tutor's men are nearby; making enough noise will naturally draw attention."
choices.visible_cost: "The longer we stall, the more variables arise; Ling Yuan might lose patience"
choices.visible_reward: "Without spending a single soldier, borrow strength to dissolve the crisis"
choices.risk_hint: "External forces may have ulterior motives; introducing a third party is not necessarily a good thing"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji did not speak.

He merely slightly turned aside, assuming a posture of 'ready to listen.' That composure made Ling Yuan increasingly uneasy—just what trump card did this boy still hold?

At that moment, commotion came from the distance.

It was the Imperial Prince's Grand Tutor's men! They seemed to have encountered Demonic Path ambush at the edge of the forbidden grounds and were engaged in fierce battle.

Ling Yuan frowned, his gaze flickering.

"...Very well." He suddenly withdrew his hand, speaking coldly: "This old man will remember today's matter."

His figure gradually faded into the shadows:

"Next time, you may not be so fortunate."

The threatening words echoed above the altar.

Chen Ji stared at the direction where Ling Yuan vanished, a cold smile curving his lips.

No trump card was the greatest trump card.

What he gambled on was Ling Yuan's suspicion."

choices.memory_label: 利用凌渊多疑性格化解当面对峙

text.content:
"After Ling Yuan's figure vanished, Chen Ji finally exhaled.

His back was soaked with cold sweat.

Those words just now—he had won. Won through Ling Yuan's hundreds of years of obsession, won through his understanding of this old fox.

But he knew this was only temporary.

Ling Yuan would not let this go.

And he, before that moment—

Must rescue Chen Nian.

He turned and strode toward the altar's center.

The Dragon Vein power still surged madly, seal chains breaking one after another. Chen Nian sat quietly there, her expression peaceful, as if merely sleeping.

Chen Ji crouched down, his trembling hand reaching out—

Just as his fingertips were about to touch Chen Nian.

Her eyes opened."

dialogue.content:
"Those eyes, clear as mountain spring water, yet so profound no bottom could be seen.

"Brother."

A gentle call, yet like thunder exploding in Chen Ji's mind.

Seven years.

A full seven years, he finally heard this voice again.

"Niannian..."

His voice was hoarse beyond recognition. The young woman sitting cross-legged before him was indeed his sister he had desperately sought for seven years—Chen Nian.

"I waited for you a long time." Chen Nian tilted her head slightly, a gentle smile floating at her lips. "Just as you waited for me."

She reached out, gently grasping Chen Ji's fingers.

That palm was warm and real.

Not a dream.

"Brother," Chen Nian's voice suddenly lowered, "I have many things to tell you—about the Tianji Record, about the Eye of Heavenly Way, about... the truth of all this."

She raised her head, a flicker of worry in her eyes:

"But first—we do not have much time."

text.content:
"Dragon Vein power surged toward the altar like a tide, the remnants of the seal accelerating its collapse.

Chen Nian stood up, the seal chains on her body all shattered. At her brow center, that mysterious talisman glowed even brighter than before, faintly emanating an aura that did not belong to mortals.

"I can sense—" she closed her eyes, her brow slightly knitting, "'It' is watching me."

Chen Ji's heart tightened.

'It.'

Besides that existence, nothing else could make Chen Nian so vigilant.

The Eye of Heavenly Way.

"Brother," Chen Nian opened her eyes, her gaze determined, "the Ninth Page of the Tianji Record must be opened by me. But before that—"

She raised her hand, a golden light flowing from her palm into Chen Ji's brow center:

"You need to know some things."

In an instant, massive information flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—

About the origin of the Tianji Record.
About the Eye of Heavenly Way's true purpose.
About... Chen Ji's own origins.

His pupils contracted sharply.

"So that's how it is..." he murmured, "So from the very beginning—I have been on 'Its' chessboard."

"The altar began to shake violently.

Dragon Vein power had broken through the final defense line; the entire seventh level teetered on the edge of collapse. Chen Ji grabbed Chen Nian's hand and rushed toward the exit.

"Go!"

The two transformed into streams of light, racing through the collapsing corridor. Behind them rolled the Dragon Vein torrent, ahead lay unknown dangers.

But at this moment, Chen Ji's heart was exceptionally calm.

Because he finally understood everything.

The Tianji Record, the Eye of Heavenly Way, the prophets through generations... even his own fate. From beginning to end, all were merely the game set up by that transcendent consciousness.

But so what?

He turned his head, glancing at Chen Nian beside him.

The sister was found. The truth was already known.

Next—

He would overturn this entire game.

"Chen Ji!"

A familiar voice came from behind. It was Su Qingyao, and also Ye Qing!

They actually followed?

Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward.

It seemed this game would be far more interesting than anticipated."

"At the corridor's end, a figure blocked the path.

Not an enemy.

It was Mo Xiansheng.

That mysterious existence dwelling within the first page of the Tianji Record in spirit soul form, now manifested in physical form. His features were clearer than ever before, his eyes carrying a trace of... compassion that Chen Ji had never witnessed.

"Master," Mo Xiansheng bowed deeply, "this old servant has waited for this day far too long."

He straightened, his gaze passing over Chen Ji to fall upon Chen Nian:

"Miss, you have finally awakened."

Chen Nian slightly nodded: "Mo Xiansheng, you have labored."

Chen Ji furrowed his brow.

He had acutely caught a keyword—"Miss."

This address was not ordinary respect.

That was...

"Master," Mo Xiansheng seemed to see through his confusion, speaking slowly, "some matters are time to tell you now. Regarding your origins, regarding the Tianji Record's true inheritance..."

He paused, his voice low:

"Regarding—why you were chosen by the Tianji Record."

"The commotion outside the forbidden grounds grew ever closer.

The Imperial Prince's Grand Tutor's men, the Demonic Path ambush, and Ling Yuan who might return anytime... all forces were converging upon this place.

And at the center of this chaos, Chen Ji stood still, feeling the weight of destiny for the first time.

Chen Nian watched him silently, her eyes full of trust.

Mo Xiansheng stood with lowered head, awaiting the next directive.

In the distance, Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's figures grew ever clearer.

Chen Ji drew a deep breath.

He had laid his plans for seven years, calculating the world, all for this moment.

Now—

The pieces were exhausted; the game should be held by himself.

"Mo Xiansheng," he spoke, his voice calm yet firm, "whatever needs to be said, I wish to hear it now."

He paused, glancing at Chen Nian beside him:

"However—let's talk while walking."

The Dragon Vein awakens, the world falls into chaos.

And he, Chen Ji, will in the chaos grasp the pieces and place his stones.

This game, he will win.

Even if the opponent is—Heavenly Way."

dialogue.content:
"Chen Nian suddenly tightened her grip on Chen Ji's hand.

"Brother," her voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve, "whatever happens next—we face it together."

Seven years apart, seven years of waiting.

What she awaited was not merely the day of her redemption.

But—this moment of standing shoulder to shoulder with her brother.

Chen Ji lowered his gaze, looking at that face seven-tenths similar to his own.

Seven years of planning, seven years of scheming, seven years of solitude...

At this moment, all of it was worth it.

"Alright."

He responded softly, a faint smile rising at the corner of his lips.

That was his first genuine smile in seven years.

"Together."
